caveats: Plan-derived schematic of two structurally topped Voya towers. Curved balcony outline and recessed wall outline are traced from the developer presentation; scale is estimated from printed suite areas, with ±5% dimensional uncertainty. Taller maximum 142.25 m comes from a published observer of engineering drawings, not a drawing recovered by this project. Shorter maximum is UNKNOWN: the displayed approximately 124 m envelope subtracts six reported 10-foot upper floors from the taller maximum, assuming equal roof allowance; allow ±6 m and do not treat it as a verified height. Location uses the developer community diagram and adjacent mapped Avia controls; allow ±8 m taller and ±15 m shorter placement uncertainty. Identical generic published tower plate applied to both; detailed floor-by-floor changes and mechanical roof cavities are omitted. Horizontal slab bands are illustrative and their elevations are not construction measurements. Shared stepped podium geometry is not reconstructed because its complete dimensioned plans were not recovered. Both towers were physically topped by July 2026; this model does not establish occupancy or complete cladding.
